content.text: Digital creators face significant challenges in monetizing their work due to restrictive [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-trap-most-creators|The Payment]] platforms like PayPal and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-actually-how-works-3|stripe]]. In regions where these services are unavailable, the ability to sell digital products effectively is severely limited. Cloudflare R2 offers a powerful alternative for hosting digital products, ensuring creators can store and deliver their content without these restrictions. This guide explores how to leverage Cloudflare R2 for seamless digital product delivery, eliminating platform fees and enabling the use of cryptocurrencies for payment processing.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage service designed for developers and businesses looking to store large amounts of data without the drawbacks of traditional cloud storage providers. Unlike platforms like Gumroad that impose steep fees on sales—10% on every transaction—Cloudflare R2 allows you to store digital files with a pay-as-you-go model that can significantly reduce your overhead costs. By integrating R2 with NOWPayments, you can automate payment processing and file delivery, providing a streamlined experience for your customers while maximizing your profits.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] of using Cloudflare R2 for digital product delivery revolves around its integration with serverless technologies. By utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can create backend logic that handles payment verification and file delivery seamlessly. When a customer purchases a product, NOWPayments processes the transaction in real-time, and a webhook triggers the delivery of the digital file from Cloudflare R2. This setup ensures that your products are delivered automatically without manual intervention, allowing you to focus on creating more content.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically built for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are not accessible. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software in places like Nigeria, Ghana, or Zimbabwe, this solution is tailored for you. It removes the barriers imposed by conventional platforms, offering you full control over your sales process. Digital creators can now retain more of their earnings, as the fees are significantly lower compared to services like Gumroad, which can take a hefty cut of your profits.
Cloudflare R2 offers a cost-effective storage solution compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To effectively utilize Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery, you'll need a combination of several tools. Start with Cloudflare R2 for storage, and couple it with Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Use NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments, ensuring minimal fees and immediate verification. Finally, you can employ Google Sheets or Supabase to manage your order data. This stack not only provides a robust infrastructure but also ensures you retain ownership of your data and products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with deploying your digital product store using Cloudflare R2, begin by signing up for a Cloudflare account and creating an R2 bucket for your files. Next, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing by following their setup guide. Then, construct your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle payment verification and automate file delivery. Once everything is configured, you can launch your store and start selling your digital products without the need for conventional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is entirely possible by leveraging Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments. Cloudflare R2 serves as your digital storage solution, while NOWPayments handles cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies with a minimal fee structure. This setup ensures a smooth sales process without traditional platform dependencies.
NOWPayments ensures you keep more of your earnings with low transaction fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your sovereign digital commerce stack, empowering you to sell directly to your customers with ease.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

You can sell an ebook online by using Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This allows you to bypass traditional platforms and retain more of your earnings.

Utilizing Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments provides a cost-effective way to sell digital downloads. With minimal fees compared to conventional platforms, you can maximize your profitability.

Yes, by setting up your digital commerce stack using Cloudflare R2 and NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% on transactions, significantly lower than the fees charged by platforms like Gumroad, which can reach 10% per sale.
Is it difficult to set up Cloudflare R2 for my digital products?
Setting up Cloudflare R2 is straightforward. With clear documentation and integration options, you can have your digital products stored and ready for delivery in no time.
